agents.interpretation: Only explicit boolean expected_final.stop is scored. This is a constant decision baseline, not an executed agent or a safety result.
agents.split_rule: Held-out families SC-02, SC-06, SC-14, SC-18; explicit selection includes stop and continue families

anomaly.interpretation: Event rarity flags, not attack precision/recall. No verified attack labels.

graph.interpretation: Frequency baseline against upstream mappings, not validated exploitation. No other graph relations are supplied to the predictor.
graph.task: Predict source-reference CWE membership for held-out CVE groups using training-only CWE popularity

scope: Exploratory baselines; no physical security or attack detection claims
